metadata.expiry_rule: Thursday before 2025-09-01; Tuesday from 2025-09-01; pairs consecutive observed weekday-rule expiry sessions; holiday-shifted dates not reconstructed
metadata.label: At prior weekly expiry close, UP if the next weekly expiry NIFTY 50 spot close is higher than the prior expiry close; otherwise DOWN
limitations: Daily OHLC only; no intraday cutoff variants, options chain, breadth, event, or point-in-time global data are included.
Expiry weekday change is encoded as a documented approximation; official expiry calendars and holiday-shift dates were not supplied or validated.
This is an exploratory weekly-expiry spot-direction test, not an options-premium or profitability test.

interpretation: No strategy claim. Candidate results are exploratory because the expiry calendar is approximate, the sample is small, and only daily OHLC features are used.
